run.name: Maximus Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (MMS)
run.summary: Maximus is a moderately levered, covenant-compliant government services credit. Net leverage has risen to 2.25x on buybacks and a receivables build, and liquidity depends on fourth-quarter collections and the revolver. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is MAXIMUS, INC..

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 1,653,548, cash 56,953, LTM adjusted EBITDA 711,009 (C1); Credit Agreement ratio 2.00. Issuer-adjusted EBITDA, not the covenant measure; the seasonal fourth-quarter collections (fiscal Q4 2025 free cash flow was 641,845, C13) have not yet occurred

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM adjusted EBITDA 711,009 over LTM interest payments 86,279 (C1); Credit Agreement coverage 8.72. The 325 million added to Term Loan B on May 27, 2026 bore interest for only part of the quarter, so LTM cash interest understates the run-rate

cash.basis: Cash. Cash 56,953 thousand (Q3 10-Q page:5); "approximately $730.0 million" (Q3 10-Q page:32), equal to 750.0 less the 20.0 drawn; letters of credit not stated. Excludes 96.3 of restricted cash and the receivable-sale facility

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: The Credit Agreement, ratings, ownership detail and everything after August 6, 2026 are not supplied, so creditor protections and fiscal 2026 outcomes cannot be verified.
CP-1 main limitation: Credit Agreement definitions and letter of credit usage are not supplied, and nothing after August 6, 2026 is covered, including fiscal fourth quarter results.
